mapper.select: SELECT * FROM km_blog_category WHERE path = #{path} AND del_flag = '0' LIMIT 1

SELECT c.*, COALESCE(a.article_count, 0) AS article_count, d.name AS dataset_name, d.kb_id AS kb_id, kb.name AS kb_name FROM km_blog_category c LEFT JOIN km_dataset d ON d.id = c.dataset_id LEFT JOIN km_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.kb_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT bc.id AS topic_id, COUNT(ka.id) AS article_count FROM km_blog_category bc LEFT JOIN km_blog_category sub ON (sub.path = bc.path OR sub.path LIKE CONCAT(bc.path, '/%')) AND sub.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN km_blog_article ka ON ka.category_id = sub.id AND ka.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND ka.del_flag = '0' WHERE bc.is_topic = '1' AND bc.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY bc.id ) a ON a.topic_id = c.id WHERE c.is_topic = '1' AND c.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY c.order_num ASC, c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.*, COALESCE(cnt.article_count, 0) AS article_count, d.name AS dataset_name, d.kb_id AS kb_id, kb.name AS kb_name FROM km_blog_category c LEFT JOIN km_dataset d ON d.id = c.dataset_id LEFT JOIN km_knowledge_base kb ON kb.id = d.kb_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS article_count FROM km_blog_article WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY category_id ) cnt ON cnt.category_id = c.id WHERE c.del_flag = '0'
AND (c.id = #{topicId} OR c.path LIKE CONCAT(( SELECT path FROM km_blog_category WHERE id = #{topicId} AND del_flag = '0' ), '/%'))
ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.order_num ASC, c.create_time ASC
